title: Fusion Times Metaverse
tagline: Created this Multiplayer metaverse, where you can get the option to roam around Medieval Spain or Modern NYC with a car of your choice.
description: Photon recently released the networking package Fusion, which is significantly faster and consumes much fewer resources compared to the existing networking package Photon PUN. Here I Implemented Fusion to integrate the multiplayer feature. One of the biggest challenges of Metaverse is the scalability of users, so the better the networking tool, the better the application becomes.
how_its_made: Fusion is a relatively new package, and very few online resources are available. So whenever I faced any issues, the only help was official documentation.
